# retained 1.0.17 release evidence - frozen fixture

Real bytes copied verbatim from the operator host retained
`target/release-evidence/1.0.17/` for the published `1.0.17` release, whose digests are
already recorded in the published transparency chain.

These are **frozen**. No test may regenerate them, and no writer in this repo may produce
them. They exist to prove that the retained-artifact readers can still validate evidence
cut before later required keys were introduced - a claim a fixture generated by the code
under test cannot make.

`ledger.json` declares `schema_version: 1` and carries 16 top-level keys. It does not
carry an `nvattest` section, because the nvattest release binding landed after this
release was cut. Its sibling `proofs/*.json` install/smoke receipts each carry a
`schema_version` field that no reader currently dispatches on.
